about:
## About

**Currency Tracking** is a lightweight, standalone World of Warcraft addon that displays your selected **currencies** and **stackable items** directly on your game screen.

Use the movable tracking frame to keep important resources visible wherever you prefer. Track currencies alongside stackable items such as meat, crafting materials, parts, potions, herbs, and other profession-related items.

Hover over the on-screen tracker to view a tooltip containing your available currencies. You can also choose to display your character's total money.

## Features

*   Track selected **currencies** directly on your screen
*   Track selected **stackable items**, including crafting materials and consumables. On Retail, item counts include your bags, character bank and Warband bank
*   Move the tracking frame anywhere on the screen
*   Show or hide item and currency amounts
*   Optionally show your total gold, silver, and copper
*   Optionally hide entries with a zero quantity
*   Configure icon placement, scale, transparency, and layout
*   Set a maximum number of tracked entries per row
*   Automatically hide the tracking frame during combat, pet battles, or battlegrounds
*   View your currency information in a tooltip
*   **Click to track:** Alt+Right-click an item in your bags, bank, loot window, merchant window or a chat link to start or stop tracking it
*   Track any item, not only those in the predefined lists, through the **Custom Items** list
*   Right-click the tracker to open the addon options

## How to use

Manage tracked **currencies** and **items** from the addon's options window.

When the on-screen tracker is visible, right-click a tracked currency or item to open the options directly. From there, you can choose what to track and customize display settings such as icon order, visibility, scale, transparency, and frame position.

You can track as many currencies and items as your screen layout allows.

### Click to track

Hold **Alt** and **right-click** an item to start or stop tracking it. This works on items in your:

*   Bags
*   Character bank and Warband bank
*   Loot and merchant windows
*   Chat item links

Click to track is not available in the guild bank, because right-clicking a guild bank slot withdraws the item.

Use the same combination on an item in the on-screen tracker to stop tracking it. When enabled, the item tooltip shows a short hint with the current combination.

You can change the modifier key (**Alt**, **Ctrl** or **Alt+Ctrl**) and the mouse button, or turn the feature off, under **Options → Click to track**. Shift is never used, so chat linking and stack splitting keep working as usual.

### Custom Items

Items that you add by clicking, but that are not part of the predefined item lists, appear in the **Custom Items** category of the options. There you can:

*   Check or uncheck items to show or hide them on the tracker
*   Add an item by entering its item ID, pasting an item link, or pasting a Wowhead item URL
*   Remove an item from the list with the **Remove** button

## Compatibility

*   Supports **LibDataBroker (LDB)** displays
*   Supports **Titan Panel**
*   Compatible with **ElvUI**
*   Supports current World of Warcraft clients as listed in the project file information

## Donations

If you enjoy Currency Tracking and would like to support its continued development, donations are greatly appreciated—no matter the amount.

# Currency Tracking

## Revision History:

### v8.06 (Nov. 06, 2026)

- Added click-to-track for items: Alt+Right-click (configurable) an item in your bags, bank, loot window, merchant window or a chat link to start or stop tracking it
  - Not available in the guild bank, as right-clicking a guild bank slot withdraws the item
- Using the same combination on an item in the on-screen tracker stops tracking it
- Added a "Click to track" options group: modifier key (Alt, Ctrl, Alt+Ctrl or disabled), mouse button, and an optional hint in item tooltips
- Added a "Custom Items" category for tracked items that are not in the predefined lists
  - Add items by item ID, item link or Wowhead URL
  - Unchecked items stay in the list until removed with the Remove button
- Retail: item counts now include the Warband bank (and reagent bank)
- Custom items are now pre-cached together with the predefined items
- Localized the new strings for all supported locales
